title: When the Orbit Breaks
author: Emrys Nystrom
blurb: Tamsin Hartwell, a decommissioned war android paying off its debts, has spent seven years hauling cargo through contested orbits. Then an unfamiliar name shows up on the manifest of a ship that never flew — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must prove a massacre happened when every record says otherwise, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
